local counts, words = {}, {}
for word in io.read('a'):gmatch('%a+') do
  word = word:lower()
  if not counts[word] then counts[word] = 0; words[#words + 1] = word end
  counts[word] = counts[word] + 1
end
table.sort(words, function(a, b) if counts[a] ~= counts[b] then return counts[a] > counts[b] end return a < b end)
for i = 1, math.min(3, #words) do print(words[i], counts[words[i]]) end

local n = tonumber(arg[1])
local composite, primes = {}, {}
for i = 2, n do
  if not composite[i] then primes[#primes + 1] = i; for j = i * i, n, i do composite[j] = true end end
end
print(#primes, primes[#primes])

local function gcd(a, b) while b ~= 0 do a, b = b, a % b end return a end
local g, l
for n in io.read('a'):gmatch('%d+') do
  n = math.tointeger(tonumber(n))
  if not g then g, l = n, n else g = gcd(g, n); l = l // gcd(l, n) * n end
end
print(g, l)

local stats = require('stats')
local values = {}
for n in io.read('a'):gmatch('%-?%d+%.?%d*') do values[#values + 1] = tonumber(n) end
print(string.format('%.2f %.2f', stats.mean(values), stats.median(values)))

local function permutations(s)
  return coroutine.wrap(function()
    local function permute(prefix, rest)
      if #rest == 0 then coroutine.yield(prefix) return end
      for i = 1, #rest do permute(prefix .. rest:sub(i, i), rest:sub(1, i - 1) .. rest:sub(i + 1)) end
    end
    permute('', s)
  end)
end
local all = {}
for p in permutations(arg[1]) do all[#all + 1] = p end
print(#all, table.concat(all, ','))

local good, bad = 0, 0
for line in io.lines() do
  local ok = pcall(function() local n = tonumber(line); if not n then error('not a number: ' .. line) end good = good + n end)
  if not ok then bad = bad + 1 end
end
print(good, bad)
